article.story: MUNCIE, Ind. -- — Sean Blake scored 20 points and Ball State beat NAIA member Brescia 89-64 on Monday night. Blake also contributed five assists and four steals for the Cardinals (1-2). Javion Guy-King scored 17 and Trey Lewis added 13 points. Ajani Blyden finished with 17 points and eight rebounds for the Bearcats. Ty Price added 16 points and four assists and Kabryen Tinson scored 11. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
